premises.text: Huge volumes of photos are shared daily and it is hard to find pictures you like
premises.evidence_span: One and a half million pictures are shared every day, such as this one. And a lot of fast-growing companies, such as Instagram, YFrog, and TwitPic, are sharing these photos. The question is, how do you find pictures you like?

premises.text: Skyline collects interests from social networks (Facebook likes, Twitter searches/hashtags; Foursquare planned)
premises.evidence_span: We connect to your social networks to collect your interests. We really believe interests are more than just people. They can be something, someone, or somewhere

premises.text: Matches personal interests to a stream of over a million photos a day from Instagram and similar services into a personal skyline
premises.evidence_span: Then we collect over a million pictures a day from services such as Instagram, TwitPic, and WhyFrog

premises.text: Skylines are real-time photo streams sortable by recency, picture-rank algorithm, friends, location, and events
premises.evidence_span: It's a real-time stream of photos with the most recent pictures shown on top. You can also sort the pictures by our picture rank algorithm, or only show photos from your friends

premises.text: Product ships as website plus iPhone and Android apps with shared interest-based skylines, plus back channel and widgets
premises.evidence_span: We are not only launching this as a website, but also as an app, both on iPhone and on Android

premises.text: Monetization via brand interest/location/time targeting and site widgets with ad revenue share or monthly ad-free fees
premises.evidence_span: Brands can target an interest, like TechCrunch Disrupt, if they want, combined with location or time
